column1: # The subjects the runtime oracle is run against, at PINNED commits.
# A subject qualifies on three counts: it is pure Python, its test suite runs from a
# clean checkout with no service and no network, and the suite exercises the library
# rather than a CLI wrapper around it. The suite is the DRIVER; nothing here is a
# fixture and nothing here is committed to this repository.
